description: This file defines the interface and data structures for Distributed Switch Architecture (DSA) in Zephyr OS, including function prototypes, callback types, and configuration structures for DSA switch management.

methods.name: dsa_tx
methods.description: Generic function for passing packets from slave DSA interface to master.

methods.name: dsa_register_recv_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for receiving packets on a network interface.

methods.name: dsa_net_recv
methods.description: Sets DSA interface to a packet and returns the slave network interface.

methods.name: dsa_register_master_tx
methods.description: Registers a transmit function for the master interface.

methods.name: dsa_is_port_master
methods.description: Checks if a network interface port is a master port.

methods.name: dsa_get_slave_port
methods.description: Retrieves the network interface of a slave port.

methods.name: dsa_switch_read
methods.description: Reads a register value from the DSA switch.

methods.name: dsa_switch_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register in the DSA switch.

methods.name: dsa_switch_set_mac_table_entry
methods.description: Sets a static MAC address table entry in the DSA switch.

methods.name: dsa_switch_get_mac_table_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a static MAC address table entry from the DSA switch.
